inj.note: Campbell suffered a neck injury while making a tackle in the third quarter of last Sunday's win over Minnesota and remains in the hospital. Detroit head coach Dan Campbell shared Friday that the linebacker continues to improve, but his placement on IR means he'll miss at least the team's next four games. K.J. Britt, who Detroit signed off New England's practice squad Wednesday, may be asked to immediately step into a starting role.

news.h: Lions grind past Dolphins 19-9 as Jahmyr Gibbs scores and Jake Bates makes 4 field goals
news.d: — The Detroit Lions have repeated a mantra all week in the aftermath of a scary neck injury to All-Pro linebacker Jack Campbell.

news.h: Lions' Jack Campbell has full movement in lower body after neck injury
news.d: Lions All-Pro linebacker Jack Campbell released a statement Wednesday saying he has full movement in his lower body and is making progress with movement in his upper body as he recovers from a neck injury, suffered in Sunday's game.

news.h: Lions LB Jack Campbell still in hospital, but signs positive
news.d: Lions linebacker Jack Campbell is still in the hospital for evaluation and monitoring of a neck injury, but the team said in a statement "preliminary indications are positive."

news.h: Lions linebacker Jack Campbell placed on backboard, carted off vs. Vikings
news.d: Lions All-Pro linebacker Jack Campbell was placed on a backboard and carted off the field early in the fourth quarter Sunday against the Vikings.
